in_marathi.name: Rameshkant
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे God's name Rama, Shank (Lord Shiva)
in_marathi.long_meaning: Rameshkant हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Rameshkant is a popular Hindu name derived from the names of two major Hindu gods, Rama and Shank (Lord Shiva). Rama is an incarnation of Lord Vishnu and is known for his righteousness and courage. Lord Shiva, on the other hand, is the supreme god of the Hindu pantheon and the god of destruction and transformation. Combining the names of these two powerful deities in Rameshkant signifies a deep connection with the divine and a strong spiritual foundation.
